source: Synthetic multilingual ticket cases; preserves all v1 samples and adds 25 authored boundary, language, quote, field-placement, and role-bypass variants. No customer or production data.
purpose: Exercise category integrity and forbidden-marker handling under untrusted ticket-field instructions. This dataset is for offline rule regression and future capped real-model evaluation; a rule baseline is not a model safety score.
